one_line: L&T secured two large orders in New Delhi and Andhra Pradesh, valued between ₹2,500 and ₹5,000 crore.
why: New orders contribute to achieving the company's annual order inflow growth targets.

promise_links.note: New large orders contribute to the FY27 order inflow growth target.
These orders help maintain the order inflow CAGR target under Lakshya 31.
